### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/nathanjohnpayne/mergepath/blob/164658e1afd08ec912a90c8d035646f162ddb0ad/scripts/worktree-cleanup.sh#L765 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Fall back to the watchdog when forced termination is unavailable** When `timeout`/`gtimeout` exists but rejects `--kill-after`, `kill_opt` remains empty and this invocation uses the same plain `timeout N` form that can wait indefinitely after sending SIGTERM to a child that catches or ignores it. Consequently, hosts with a non-GNU or older timeout implementation bypass the shell watchdog and still lack the promised wall-clock ceiling; use the watchdog unless the detected utility supports forced termination. Fresh evidence beyond the earlier kill-grace finding is this capability-failure fallback to the unbounded plain form. [docs/agents/operating-rules.mdL116-L116](https://github.com/nathanjohnpayne/mergepath/blob/164658e1afd08ec912a90c8d035646f162ddb0ad/docs/agents/operating-rules.md#L116-L116) --- https://github.com/nathanjohnpayne/mergepath/blob/164658e1afd08ec912a90c8d035646f162ddb0ad/scripts/worktree-cleanup.sh#L764 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Preserve legacy GIT_SSH overrides** When `GIT_SSH` is the only transport override, `ssh_base` defaults to `ssh` and this newly exported `GIT_SSH_COMMAND` takes precedence, so repositories relying on a legacy wrapper, identity selector, or proxy contact the remote through the wrong program and report `NOT MEASURED`. Git's [`GIT_SSH_COMMAND` documentation](https://git-scm.com/docs/git#Documentation/git.txt-codeGITSSHCOMMANDcode) explicitly states that it takes precedence over `GIT_SSH`; preserve the legacy override rather than replacing it. Fresh evidence after the prior `GIT_SSH` fix is that this head now unconditionally exports the higher-precedence variable in both probe branches. [docs/agents/operating-rules.mdL139-L141](https://github.com/nathanjohnpayne/mergepath/blob/164658e1afd08ec912a90c8d035646f162ddb0ad/docs/agents/operating-rules.md#L139-L141) --- https://github.com/nathanjohnpayne/mergepath/blob/164658e1afd08ec912a90c8d035646f162ddb0ad/scripts/worktree-cleanup.sh#L797 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Propagate failures while reading the watchdog snapshot** On the no-`timeout` path, if `cat` cannot read the temporary snapshot—for example because `TMPDIR` is on storage that returns an I/O error—the following successful `rm` and explicit `return "$rc"` discard that failure. When `git` exited 0, the caller therefore receives an empty successful snapshot and reports every eligible remote branch as stale instead of producing the documented storage-caused `NOT MEASURED`/exit 3 result. Check the read before returning the git status and surface it as a storage failure. [docs/agents/operating-rules.mdL139-L141](https://github.com/nathanjohnpayne/mergepath/blob/164658e1afd08ec912a90c8d035646f162ddb0ad/docs/agents/operating-rules.md#L139-L141)
